name: TANCO
recent: Tanco Holdings 与 CNECC 组成的联营公司获得 RM700 million 的 Pulau Indah 物流仓库合约，并成立 XH Tanco Precast Building Sdn. Bhd.。公司同时发布 2026 财年第一季业绩，录得净亏损 1.94 million 令吉。此外，公司将在 2026 年 12 月 9 日召开第 67 届常年股东大会。
notable: Tanco–CNECC 联营公司获得价值 RM700 million 的 Pulau Indah 物流仓库合约。
公司成立子公司 XH Tanco Precast Building Sdn. Bhd.。
公司发布 2026 财年第一季业绩，净亏损 1.94 million 令吉。
risks: 公司第一季净亏损 1.94 million 令吉，而去年同期为净利。
集团董事总经理 Dato' Sri Andrew Tan Jun Suan 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次增持公司股份。
earnings: 2026 财年第一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 38.76 million 令吉，环比增长 9.7%，同比增长 19.5%；净亏损为 3.35 million 令吉，净利率为 -8.6%，而上一季度净利率为 0.3%。

recent_en: Tanco Holdings' joint venture with CNECC secured a RM700 million logistics warehouse contract in Pulau Indah, and the company incorporated XH Tanco Precast Building Sdn. Bhd. It also reported a Q1 FY2026 net loss of RM1.94 million.
notable_en: The Tanco–CNECC consortium was awarded a RM700 million logistics warehouse contract in Pulau Indah.
The company incorporated a subsidiary, XH Tanco Precast Building Sdn. Bhd.
The company reported a Q1 FY2026 net loss of RM1.94 million.
risks_en: The company posted a Q1 net loss of RM1.94 million, compared with a net profit a year earlier.
Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Andrew Tan Jun Suan acquired shares multiple times between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For Q1 FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM38.76 million, up 9.7% QoQ and 19.5% YoY; net loss was RM3.35 million with a net margin of -8.6%, compared with a net margin of 0.3% in the previous quarter.
